stem:
Read this quotation from paragraph 10 of the article “Paper Calendars Endure Despite the Digital Age.”

It may seem counterintuitive that a print product can thrive in the digital age.

Why does the author include the quotation?
instruction: Use “Paper Calendars Endure Despite the Digital Age” to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: To show that he is qualified to discuss print and digital purchases

options.label: G
options.text: To explain that people cannot draw conclusions about print versus digital products

options.label: H
options.text: To emphasize that he remains skeptical about the popularity of calendars

options.label: J
options.text: To indicate that the information he presents may surprise some readers

visual_elements: quotation box containing: It may seem counterintuitive that a print product can thrive in the digital age.
